title: REQ · Player contribution history is routed at GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions
summary: Router serves Mine at the player/me path and drops the legacy mine path
description: Context: server.New registers r.Get("/api/v1/contributions/mine", ch.Mine) at line 77. Desired behavior: register ch.Mine at /api/v1/player/me/contributions and remove the legacy registration. Expected result: the legacy path falls through to /contributions/{id} and responds 404 for the unknown id "mine". Why: consistent player-scoped API.
acceptance_criteria: Given a session cookie and round_id, when GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions is called, then status is 200 and body is a JSON array
Given a session cookie, when GET /api/v1/contributions/mine is called, then status is 404
Given no cookie, when GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions is called, then status is 401
technical_constraints: Route must be registered after ch is constructed
